title: Assistant Team Leader - FCM After Hours
description:

• Act as a culture champion by leading with positivity and supporting team engagement

• Identify team members requiring additional support and act as a communication bridge between the team and leadership

• Investigate and resolve consultant and agent queries in a timely manner

• Conduct staff inductions and support onboarding activities for new team members

• Support leadership development initiatives and take ownership of assigned directorship responsibilities

• Complete reporting activities and contribute to end-of-month processes and business development initiatives

• Perform consultant after-hours responsibilities when not actively engaged in leadership duties

• Deliver outstanding customer service while ensuring KPI achievement and operational accuracy

• Support change management initiatives and maintain compliance with Corporate After Hours processes

• Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and commitment to company values and philosophies.

What you will need:

• Proven experience as a Corporate After-Hours Consultant with a consistent record of meeting and exceeding KPI targets.

• Strong knowledge of Corporate After Hours processes and behavioural expectations.

• Previous leadership experience in a similar environment or one with comparable values.

• Experience managing disputes and resolving issues effectively.

• Proven ability to support and manage change initiatives.

• Proficiency in operational systems including Sabre, Amadeus, Lumina, Salesforce Agent Workspace, and Genesys.

• Strong capability interpreting and calculating fares, change fees, and additional collections.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong stakeholder engagement capability.

• Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a 24/7 operational environment

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer - Developer Experience

Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 140 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.

Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns.

Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to drive the overarching strategy, technical vision, and execution across Nubank’s Quality & Developer Experience ecosystem. You will sit at the epicenter of our engineering transformation.

This role goes far beyond traditional quality assurance or testing; you will own the end-to-end (E2E) Developer Experience (DevEx) across the entire Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). From internal developer platform tools and boundary APIs to our suite of testing mechanisms and automated code reviews, your mission will be to architect AI-native systems that drastically reduce review latency, guarantee architectural correctness, and double engineering productivity across Nubank. Working alongside our most tenured engineering leaders and reporting into platform leadership, you will serve as the technical authority who brings fresh, market-leading perspectives from high-velocity environments to elevate our foundational standards.

Mission
Architect, scale, and operationalize an AI-transformed Developer Experience & Quality strategy so that:

- The "Secure and Quality Path" is the Default: Automated mechanisms, linting, and smart context-aware agents enforce strict architectural standards, eliminating code quality degradation caused by high-volume AI code generation.

- SDLC is Re-imagined for AI: Foundational tools across code authorship, testing, boundary APIs, and PR reviews are seamlessly integrated with state-of-the-art AI frameworks, smart LLM evaluations, and context-engineering hooks.

- Automated Approval Standards are Built: Clear deterministic checks and intelligent human-in-the-loop triggers are established to achieve safe, automated PR approvals without manual bottlenecks.

Core Responsibilities

- Architect E2E Quality & DevEx Platforms: Define and evolve the multi-year vision for our developer tooling ecosystem-covering internal developer platforms, boundary APIs, test automation suites, and pull request review systems.

- Lead the AI-Driven Code Review Evolution: Architect automated review mechanisms that leverage multi-model evaluations (e.g., using specialized LLMs to audit generated code), custom IDE/GitHub plugins, and deterministic linting to accelerate PR merge times while preventing code bloat or quality degradation.

- Define Human-in-the-Loop Boundaries: Set company-wide paradigms for when code changes can be automatically approved and merged versus when human intervention or secondary AI audits are required.

- Partner & Mentor Across Engineering: Act as a force multiplier by partnering with engineers and product managers, elevating the technical bar and instilling modern, high-velocity DevEx practices.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Robotics Software Engineer to design, build, and integrate software systems that power autonomous robots and robotic platforms. In this role you will work across the full robotics software stack, from low-level sensor integration and motion planning to high-level perception and behavioral systems. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep working knowledge of robotics frameworks, real-time systems, and sensor fusion. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop robotics software in C++ and Python, with strong attention to real-time performance and reliability.

• Design and integrate sensor data pipelines including cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, and proprioceptive sensors.

• Implement perception, localization, and mapping algorithms including SLAM and sensor fusion, integrating data from cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, and other sensors into robust real-world state estimation.

• Develop motion planning, control, and trajectory generation algorithms that respect kinematic and dynamic constraints while delivering smooth, predictable, and safe robot behavior in production environments.

• Build behavioral systems using state machines, behavior trees, or task planners.

• Integrate ROS / ROS 2 frameworks with custom hardware and embedded systems.

• Implement safety-critical patterns including watchdogs, fault detection, and safe stops.

• Build simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim) for development and testing.

• Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and ML engineers, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.

• Design and execute field tests, including data collection and post-test analysis.

• Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures - so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.

• Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

• Continuously evaluate emerging robotics technologies and frameworks, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• Five or more years of robotics software engineering experience.

• Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. title: Technical Operations Engineer (Voice & Integrations)
description:

Somos un equipo diverso y talentoso distribuido en varios países, y estamos buscando un Technical Operations Engineerpara sumarse al area Customer & Product Success (CPS), el dominio donde la tecnología se encuentra con el cliente y donde Lili y el equipo humano resuelven como uno.
Misión del Rol
Garantizar que la infraestructura técnica del lado del cliente funcione (telefonía, conectividad, integraciones, activaciones) y ser el puente de resolución técnica entre CPS y Platform.
Este rol resuelve los problemas que no son del agente conversacional ni de la plataforma core, sino de la capa intermedia que conecta a Vozy con el cliente. Sin este trabajo, los agentes que despliegan los FDEs simplemente no llegan al usuario final.
Lo que harás en:
1. Telefonía y conectividad

• Configurar, migrar y sostener troncales SIP de clientes y de Vozy : esquemas de carrier global, carrier por cuenta, troncales por Internet y por VPN.

• Diagnosticar fallas de marcación y de audio con trazas SIP y capturas de paquetes: rechazos por código 480, congestión de circuito, timeouts de timbrado, transferencias sin respuesta, invites duplicados sobre una misma llamada, audio que llega degradado desde el carrier.

• Gestionar DIDs, prefijos, enmascaramiento y matrices de enrutamiento por país, y validar por qué ruta entra el tráfico antes de configurar.

• Interlocutor directamente con carriers y con los equipos de telefonía de los clientes hasta el cierre del caso, con evidencia técnica en la mano.

• Sostener pruebas de telefonía en ventanas acordadas con cliente, incluyendo pruebas por país, numeración local y reversión de troncal al terminar.

2. Activaciones e integraciones

• Ejecutar la activación técnica de clientes nuevos: troncal SIP, conectividad, VPN, listas de IP, webhooks, SFTP y buckets de almacenamiento.

• Provisionar y migrar canales de mensajería: creación de cuenta con el proveedor de WhatsApp Business API, conexión con el Business Manager del cliente, onboarding de números y validación de saldo y estado de cuenta.

• Validar integraciones con las centrales telefónicas y contact centers del cliente, y armar la lista de chequeo de requisitos técnicos antes de cada integración.

3. Soporte y escalamiento

• Ser el primer punto de escalación técnica para FDEs y clientes en temas de telefonía e integraciones.

• Triage de tickets: exigir la información mínima (identificador de sesión, cuenta, agente, campaña, fecha y hora, evidencia) antes de investigar, y devolver lo que llegue incompleto.

• Escalar a Platform e infraestructura con contexto y propuesta, nunca con un "algo no funciona": qué falla, en qué cuenta, qué se descartó y cuál es la hipótesis.

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change - and the toolchain is the new constraint.

• The ability to work remotely with reliable internet access and a computer is a must.

• Current, valid Driver’s License

• Ability to captivate an audience while publicly speaking to large audiences

• Experience selling through industrial and construction distribution

• Experience selling PPE or industrial products to end-user companies

• Ability to lift 50lbs, climb ladders, and comfortably work at heights

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.

We're looking for a talented and motivated Software Engineer to join the Cortex AI Functions https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/aisql Platform team. AI functions are how Snowflake customers call AI directly from SQL, running models over their own tables without moving data out of the platform. Our team builds the platform that makes this work at data warehouse scale, where a single statement can expand into a large volume of inference requests that must complete predictably, within expected cost, and without compromising the query when a dependency degrades or fails.

Current projects include a new architecture for multi-modal inference, quality gates that let us ship new functions and models with confidence at batch scale, and support for input data beyond plain text. Alongside these, we work continuously on throughput, cost and reliability as customer usage grows, and on making failures in the inference path easier to detect, diagnose and recover from.

For this role, you don’t need to have a research background, including pre-training or fine-tuning models.

- Participate in all stages of building and running the platform behind Snowflake’s AI functions, from design and implementation through rollout and production support

- Serve as a mentor to less experienced engineers

- BSc in a technical field (CS, EE, Physics, Math, etc), MSc/PhD is a plus

- Experience designing and operating high-throughput services, including handling concurrency, backpressure, partial failures, and observability

- Experience designing service or RPC APIs, such as REST or gRPC

- Experience with software engineering best practices (programming, testing, version control, CI/CD, containers, agile development, etc)

At Inceptive, you will help pioneer the next generation of AI-designed drugs, with the potential to positively impact billions of people, as part of a collaborative, antedisciplinary team.

title: Software Engineer- Inference Performance
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We're looking for inference performance engineers who want to make the world's most demanding AI workloads run faster and more efficiently. You'll work across the stack, from the inference engine and runtime through scheduling, serving, and routing. Along the way you'll apply techniques like prefill/decode disaggregation, speculative decoding, and KV-cache management. You'll reason from first principles about where time and memory go, find what's holding performance back, and close the gap. Your work directly impacts how fast our customers' models run and how efficiently we serve them. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is eager to make significant contributions to the exciting field of LLM inference.

 

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

You'll get to work on these types of projects as an Inference Performance engineer:

- Agentic Kernels in Production https://www.baseten.co/blog/agentic-kernels-in-production/

- How we built the new fastest API for GLM-5.2 https://www.baseten.co/blog/how-we-built-the-new-fastest-api-for-glm-52/

- Live draft model training for speculative decoding https://www.baseten.co/blog/live-draft-model-training-for-speculative-decoding/#eliminating-traditional-bottlenecks

- Making Kimi K3 Tokenization 18x faster https://www.baseten.co/blog/making-kimi-k3-tokenization-18x-faster-for-million-token-agentic-workloads/

- The Baseten Inference Stack https://www.baseten.co/resources/guide/the-baseten-inference-stack/

- Driving model performance optimization https://www.baseten.co/blog/driving-model-performance-optimization-2024-highlights/

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Implement and productionize cutting-edge inference techniques, working deep in runtime internals. That includes quantization, speculative decoding, KV-cache reuse, chunked prefill, LoRA, guided generation for structured outputs, and custom scheduling and routing algorithms.

- Profile and optimize inference end to end, from kernel launch overhead and memory layout up to request scheduling, prefill/decode disaggregation, and cache-aware routing. Run cross-layer investigations, such as tracing a tail-latency regression from request timing through routing and batching down to a kernel.

- Turn performance into cost savings. Improve tokens per GPU-hour, raise utilization, and give customers and internal teams clear latency/throughput/cost tradeoffs.

- Bring up and tune new model architectures on new hardware quickly, often in the same week they're released.

- Build benchmarking frameworks that measure real-world performance across model architectures, batch sizes, sequence lengths, and hardware configurations.

- Contribute upstream to open-source inference engines (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM), and partner closely with model, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams to ship wins.

 

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.

- Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages, such as Python or C++.

- Familiarity with LLM optimization techniques (e.g., quantization, speculative decoding, continuous batching).

- Strong familiarity with ML libraries, especially PyTorch, TensorRT, or TensorRT-LLM.

- Demonstrated interest and experience in LLMs.

- Deep understanding of GPU architecture.

title: Head of Marketing, APJ

ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Head of Marketing, APJ based in Sydney to lead Exa's marketing across Asia Pacific and Japan.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is Exa's first senior marketing leader outside the United States. You will set the marketing strategy for Asia Pacific and Japan and run it as a commercial function, tied to the region's pipeline number. APJ is many markets with different buyers, languages, and routes to market. Deciding which ones matter first, and how Exa wins in each, is the core of the job.

Sales coverage is coming online across ANZ, Southeast Asia, and India, with a partner-led motion in Japan. You will be the marketing counterpart: deciding where to invest, which motions to run in which markets, and how a fast-moving American AI infrastructure company earns credibility with buyers in Sydney, Tokyo, Singapore, and Bengaluru.

This is a player-coach role. You will write the regional plan and then help execute it yourself, from shaping a campaign and adapting the message to hosting an executive dinner and sitting in pipeline reviews with Sales. You start as a team of one, with meaningful budget for field events, conferences, and developer events. We expect your first hire, an early-career field events marketer, to join within months, with more headcount as growth justifies.

Exa's buyers are technical, and much of our growth starts with developers who sign up and build before anyone talks to Sales. The right person understands both product-led growth with developers and account-based programs for enterprise buyers. You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to keep all of it pointed at the same priorities.

This is an AI-first role at an AI-first company. Account research, localization, campaign analysis, and reporting should be workflows you build, since one person covering a dozen markets only works if the work is automated.

This role is based in-person in Sydney, with regular travel across APJ and periodic trips to our San Francisco HQ.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

APJ MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the regional marketing plan. Translate Exa's global priorities into a plan for APJ, prioritize markets by opportunity and sales coverage, and decide where to invest across markets and programs. Own the APJ marketing budget, which centers on field events, conferences, developer events, and selective local sponsorships (including developer creators and communities). Success is measured by revenue growth.

GO-TO-MARKET BY MARKET

Build a go-to-market approach for priority markets across ANZ, Japan, Southeast Asia, and India. The right motion differs by market (direct, partner-led, or channel-based), and some markets should wait until product-led signal justifies the spend.

PIPELINE AND DEMAND

Own APJ pipeline targets. Build the programs that create qualified opportunities and move them through the cycle: account-based campaigns, executive dinners, a small number of high-value trade shows, reactivation of any stalled pipeline, and webinars or localized content. Use pipeline and conversion data to shift investment toward what works. Success is measured by pipeline and by cost per opportunity.

SALES PARTNERSHIP

Be the marketing partner to APJ Sales, SDRs, and regional partners. Align on ICP, target accounts, campaign priorities, lead routing, and follow-up

We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.
We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.
You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

Have you made something beautiful because you wanted it to exist?

Maybe you’ve built a small creative tool. Made an interface behave in a way we haven’t seen before. Used AI to turn an idea into something people can actually play with.

You’ve got a strong eye, ideas of your own and work to show for it. You might not have held a product design job yet.

We’re looking for a designer with exceptional visual craft, ideas of their own and the AI skills to turn them into working experiences. We’d like to see what you’re making.

Make things for people who make things.

At Envato , we’re building tools that help creative professionals find, generate and refine assets for their projects. We want those tools to feel as creative and considered as the work people make with them.

We’re looking for someone with fresh ideas who brings excellent visual craft and is already using AI to explore and build. You could be coming from uni, independent projects, freelance work or another creative discipline. We’re not fussed about your current job title or background, but what we do care about is raw design talent who can bring something different to the team.

What you could get your hands on

• You might prototype how a filmmaker saves a character reference and uses it across different shots. Explore how arranging and playing video clips could help someone see a story coming together. Or use motion, imagery and interaction to make an AI capability easier to understand and more enjoyable to use.

• You’ll bring different approaches, make them interactive and try them with the team and customers. Then you’ll help develop the promising ones into experiences people can use.

• This is work on the core product, not a separate collection of experiments that never makes it into customers’ hands. This work matters.

Bring your eye. Build your product experience.

• We want to see care in the typography, composition, hierarchy, motion and interaction. We’re interested in how you direct and work with AI.

• You should be curious about the person using what you’ve made, willing to share unfinished work, test things in the wild and able to change your approach when you learn something.

• You’ll work alongside experienced designers and engineers, with support on framing problems, testing ideas and getting work into the product. You won’t be expected to independently lead a whole product area from day one, but you will have real work to own, feedback to help you develop it and the opportunity to contribute things we haven’t yet thought of
Show us what you’re making.

To be considered, send us something you’ve built using AI, a finished product, prototype, website or interactive tool, and something that shows your visual craft. They can be the same project. Uni work, client work and independent experiments are all welcome.

Add a few lines about your contribution, the tools you used and the details you sweated

title: WebCenter / Content & Records Management SME
description:
We are looking for a Senior WebCenter / Content & Records Management SME to own the enterprise document and records-management solution using Oracle WebCenter Content/Records Management (along with Oracle Content Management where approved). You will oversee the full records lifecycle-including capture, classification, versioning, search, bilingual/Arabic capability, OCR, retention, legal hold, archival, and disposition-while integrating it cleanly with Oracle Fusion and approved platform extensions.
This is not a generic document-management role. It requires deep Oracle WebCenter expertise combined with records-governance capability, bilingual search/OCR awareness, security, and integration with Fusion, OIC, and custom extensions.
Key Responsibilities

•
Platform & Solution Ownership: Own enterprise document and records-management design, implementation, and configuration baselines using Oracle WebCenter Content/Records Management.

•
Lifecycle & Metadata Design: Define document capture, metadata/taxonomy/classification models, versioning, access controls, and search requirements.

•
Records Governance: Establish records declaration, retention schedules, legal holds, archival, disposition, and audit evidence in alignment with business records owners.

•
OCR & Bilingual Support: Confirm detailed requirements for OCR, bilingual/Arabic search requirements, and terminology validation.

•
System Integrations: Design document integrations with Oracle Fusion attachments, Enterprise Contracts, OIC/API connections, and approved Legal, Audit, Board, or Governance extensions.

•
Migration & Testing: Support content migration strategies and object mapping, own system integration testing (SIT) for content/records scope, and support business UAT.

•
Security & Compliance: Coordinate with the Security Lead on restricted content, record/field access, privileged content, audit trails, and retention compliance.

•
Operational Readiness: Finalize operational procedures, performance metrics, retention/audit controls, administration/user documentation, and handover materials.

Requirements
Requirements (Must-Have Criteria)

•
Experience: 8+ years of Oracle WebCenter Content / Records Management and enterprise DMS experience.

•
Technical Proficiency: Hands-on and lead experience designing and configuring WebCenter Content, document capture, versioning, access control, and search design.

•
Records Management Depth: Proven expertise in retention schedules, records declaration, legal holds, archival, disposition, and audit evidence.

•
OCR & Search: Practical experience with OCR, enterprise search, and bilingual/Arabic search requirements and terminology governance.

•
Integration Knowledge: Experience integrating WebCenter with Oracle Fusion attachments, business processes, OIC/APIs, and APEX/approved extensions.

•
Migration & Security: Demonstrated experience supporting content migrations/object mapping and enforcing security for restricted documents, record/field access, and audit trails.

•
Lifecycle Ownership: Ability to produce WebCenter configuration baselines, MD.050/MD.070 design inputs, and own testing/handover activities.

Plus Points / Preferred Qualifications

• Extensive enterprise taxonomy and metadata design examples.

• Real-world experience integrating Oracle Fusion (ERP/HCM/SCM) with WebCenter repositories.

• Background in large repository content migrations and structured reconciliation.

• Experience contributing to framework documentation such as RD.011, BF.016, TE.040, and DO.070.

• Strong understanding of production supportability, disaster recovery, and operational readiness for content platforms.

Note: Candidates with only generic SharePoint/DMS experience, WebCenter administration experience lacking records-management depth, or no bilingual search and Fusion integration experience will not be considered.

title: Senior ServiceNow Developer

Develop and enhance ServiceNow functionality using server-side and client-side scripting, including Glide API, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Scheduled Jobs

Design and configure Service Catalogs, Catalog APIs, Order Guides, ACLs, Roles, Workspaces, and UI Builder interfaces

title: Financial Systems Analyst
description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including Momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is looking for a NetSuite / Salesforce / FloQast Administrator to join our Enterprise Applications team within Finance. You'll be the day-to-day owner of configuration, user administration, and integration health across our core finance and revenue systems - the person who actually knows why a saved search broke, why a workflow stalled, or why a sync between NetSuite and Salesforce didn't fire. This role rewards curiosity and precision: you don't need to arrive as a NetSuite expert, but you do need to want to become one, and you need to be the kind of person who double-checks a config change before it touches production. You'll work closely with Finance, Accounting, Sales Ops, and Engineering, and partner with senior systems analysts and architects on the bigger roadmap items - but the daily craft of keeping these systems accurate, well-documented, and running smoothly is yours.

This role will be required to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 3 days per week.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Administer day-to-day configuration of NetSuite, Salesforce, and FloQast: user setup/deactivation, roles and permissions, saved searches, SuiteAnalytics workbooks/dashboards, Salesforce flows and validation rules, troubleshooting issues within Salesforce and Expensify User Access Review.

- Act as a backup administrator for FloQast for user setup, sync errors and questions.

- Build and maintain NetSuite SuiteFlow workflows and troubleshoot existing SuiteScript customizations - you don't need to write scripts from scratch on day one, but you should be comfortable reading one, tracing what it does, and knowing when to escalate to a developer.

- Triage and resolve support tickets from Finance and general employees related to expense reports, financial records, and account access, digging into root cause rather than just closing the ticket.

- Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between NetSuite and Salesforce - including iPaaS/middleware tools and direct API/SFTP data feeds - escalating to engineering when needed.

- Support month-end and quarter-end close by ensuring system data accuracy, running reports, and resolving reconciliation discrepancies.

- Help with the month-end close by loading files into a third-party system for the Reporting Team.

title: Apple Client Platform Engineer (Remote, US)
description:
Apple Client Platform Engineer (Remote, US)

About Alectrona

Customer experience is more than meeting an SLA.

Our team is passionate about making Apple “just work” for our clients, because we want you to experience the delight of a truly functional technology environment, without the friction of IT getting in the way. We get excited about what we do, and we love sharing that passion with our partners.

Enterprise IT becomes enjoyable again.

We actually love what we do, we take a lot of pride in the quality of our work, and for us, customer experience is paramount. The SLA is not the only metric that drives us. We get deeply invested in finding ways to keep our clients as excited as we are. In an industry that hasn’t changed much in over a decade, we are actively reimagining what clients should expect from technology vendors. So we want to show off what’s possible -- not just what’s been promised.

We treat all people as if they’re smart and know what's best.

...because our clients are smart, and they do know. We work with clients that inspire us, and whose missions we want to support. That mutual respect results in trusting relationships and productive communication about business pain points and solutions. We won’t hide behind intimidating security-speak and IT jargon. We say what we mean, and mean for clients to understand what we say.

Our clients put their people first - and so do we.

Happy employees create happy customers. Downtime is expensive, and top talent shouldn’t spend entire days downloading apps and setting up workstations. Our clients understand this, and demand the best for their people as a matter of business strategy. We bring a matching sense of purpose and excitement to every client engagement.

What you’ll do at Alectrona

You will lead professional services engagements for organizations running Apple at scale. That means designing the management platform, building the parts that do not exist yet, and telling the customer the truth about what will and will not work.

• We're a fully remote team across multiple time zones, and we expect you to work well in that environment and be willing to meet in person a few times per year, present at conferences, and be an active member of the team.

• Design, deploy, and hand over Apple management platforms: MDM, identity, patching, security tooling, and the integrations that tie them together.

• Own services engagements end to end in accordance with our company values. You scope the work, plan it, run it, document it, and close it out. We expect you to be able to effectively manage your own time and projects. Our team enjoys this flexibility and autonomy and the responsibility that comes with it.

• Solve the problems that get escalated after everyone else has tried. Packet captures, log spelunking, protocol-level MDM debugging, troubleshooting undocumented behavior in macOS.

• Understand software development concepts: automations, integrations against vendor APIs, custom agents, deployment tooling. We don't expect you to write apps, but it is important to understand the code you're deploying and know how to fix stuff that isn't working.

• Challenge customers when their plan will not survive production. Arguing for a better approach is part of the job, and you have to do it well enough to keep the relationship.

• Run scoping calls. Uncover the business driver behind the request, and then explain what the work will take in plain language.

• Support our small and medium business managed services customers alongside the rest of the Alectrona team.

• Provide technical support and guidance to our managed services customers, including properly recording notes, updating documentation, and resolving tickets within SLA targets.

• Mentor other engineers and colleagues to raise the standards and help everyone learn.

• Shape new products and services. Alectrona builds its own software, and the ideas come from the field.

• Perform all job responsibilities in alignmen

title: Principal Product Manager, Partner Integrations
description:
Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list https://www.forbes.com/companies/clickhouse/?list=cloud100, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and $250M ARR https://clickhouse.com/blog/clickhouse-tops-250m-arr-and-4000-customers, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company's sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round https://clickhouse.com/blog/clickhouse-raises-400-million-series-d-acquires-langfuse-launches-postgres. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

We're hiring a Product Manager to own partner integrations at ClickHouse. This role owns how ClickHouse shows up inside the platforms our customers already use: embedded, native experiences across the hyperscalers and developer platforms, and deeper technical integrations with strategic partners like dbt, Fivetran, Hex, and Sigma. There is a growing surface of partner work already in motion, and this role shapes where we invest in co-innovation opportunities.

This is one of the most cross-functional roles at ClickHouse. You'll work across multiple engineering teams, our partnerships and solutions teams, and the partners themselves to deliver meaningful co-innovation and integrations with complementary technologies. You'll own the technical side of our House Mates partner program and be the person who navigates the multi-org reality of getting an integration certified, listed, and live. This is a hands-on role: you'll write the specs, run the partner calls, drive certification processes, and coordinate across teams to get things over the line.

- Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for ClickHouse's Cloud integrations with strategic partners

- Seek out complementary innovation opportunities with partners. Define what a "better together" integration looks like with each strategic partner, and drive it from joint roadmap through launch.

- Navigate the trade-offs of embedded integrations: billing and metering, identity and auth, security and data residency, and coordination across ClickHouse and partner teams.

- Project-manage complex, multi-org launches: marketplace listings, certification processes, partner co-marketing, and GA timelines across multiple organizations.

- Own the technical standards and certification criteria for integrations submitted through the House Mates partner program.

- Measure and communicate co-innovation business impact, adoption and product strategy to executive leadership.

- Represent ClickHouse externally at partner events and in joint content.

- Experience shipping integrations into third-party platforms before: hyperscaler marketplaces, embedded or native integrations, ISV partnerships, or OEM/white-label work.

- Patience and resilience with partners who are unresponsive or have their own competing priorities, and you find creative ways to keep things moving anyway.

- Technical ability to understand an integration end to end, from provisioning and auth to billing and data flow, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about APIs, architecture, and technical trade-offs.

title: Director, Digital & Performance Marketing
description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne , we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne , your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Director, Digital & Performance Marketing, you will be tasked with building and scaling an AI-first performance marketing engine that drives pipeline, revenue, and growth efficiency, architecting a self-optimizing digital system that continuously informs where we invest, who we target, and how we convert. This is not a traditional demand gen or media role: you will connect audience, intent, creative, and data into a real-time, signal-driven growth engine that consistently produces a high-quality pipeline and accelerates revenue. This role sits at the center of Revenue Marketing and directly impacts pipeline creation, conversion, and CAC efficiency.
What Will You Do?
Primary responsibilities include:

• Define and own the digital marketing strategy aligned to pipeline and revenue goals; translate business priorities into clear investment strategies, channel mix, and audience focus; identify market opportunities, whitespace, and growth levers to inform planning; act as a key contributor to annual and quarterly planning, influencing budget allocation and strategic bets.

• Build and scale a digital-first pipeline generation engine across paid media, intent signals, and account-based engagement; own performance across the funnel, from engagement to pipeline to revenue; architect and optimize a multi-channel engagement strategy spanning SEM, paid social, programmatic display, CTV, audio/podcasts, Reddit, and programmatic OOH, leveraging each channel's strengths to drive coordinated, signal-based engagement across the buyer journey; use AI-driven bidding and budget allocation tools to shift spend across channels in real time, based on performance, intent signals, and account engagement; ensure programs are optimized for pipeline quality, conversion, and velocity, not just lead volume; establish clear linkage between media investment and business outcomes.

• Translate ICP, personas, and segmentation into actionable target audiences across channels; leverage first-party and third-party intent data, engagement signals, and account insights to prioritize spend; apply AI and predictive modeling to score accounts, surface buying signals, and prioritize outreach before a lead even raises their hand; use a CDP (e.g., Hightouch) to unify first-party data and activate it across paid and owned channel

title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer

Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Summary
As an AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are a hands-on bridge between SensibleAI capabilities and real-world customer outcomes. You design, implement, and harden cross-product AI solutions-spanning SensibleAI Forecast, Studio, and Agents, Genesis Blocks, and the OneStream core platform. You partner with Delivery and Engineering to validate value, improve reliability, and codify reusable patterns that others can adopt.
Primary Duties and Responsibilities

• Apply OneStream , AI, and enterprise software expertise to help customers deliver transformative AI solutions within the OneStream ecosystem.

• Play a key role in hands-on delivery for AI-focused implementations, expansion projects, and established deployments-not just early-stage POCs.

• Interact, collaborate, and present to a diverse set of stakeholders, including developers, sponsors, and executives, to deliver AI-focused implementations.

• Play a growing role in orchestrating the evolving SensibleAI Portfolio (Forecast, Studio, Agents) with OneStream core to deliver modular solutions tailored to complex financial and analytics requirements.

• Produce reusable demos, implementations, checklists, workflows, best practices, and concise instructional videos that enable Presales, Delivery, Partners, and customers to leverage your learnings.

• Diagnose and resolve AI solution field issues; document decisions and trade-offs; support Delivery and Partner teams with structured guidance.

• Collaborate with AI Delivery to harden solutions for production and with AI Engineering to channel learnings and product gaps back into roadmaps.

• Engage directly with finance and data teams; work with partner FDEs to increase capability and consistency across the ecosystem; facilitate workshops and office hours.
Required Education and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, or relevant combination of education and experience.

• 0-2 years of software engineering experience, with a focus on data science, AI, or machine learning concepts.

• 1-2 years of industry experience in Applied Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning.

• 1-3 years of experience delivering/implementing enterprise software solutions in FP&A/CPM/EPM or data/AI platforms, including at least 1 year in customer-facing build roles.

• Demonstrated success contributing to POCs or early implementations that transitioned to scaled rollout or productized assets.

• Strong SQL; data modeling and ETL/ELT; REST APIs, identity/security basics.

• Experience in Python and/or C#; automation and packaging; familiarity with containerization is a plus.

• Experience in producing insightful data visualizations of complex concepts and datasets.
Preferred Education and Experience

• Direct experience with OneStream implementations or building Genesis Blocks / Marketplace content.

• Direct experience within a prior Forward Deployed Engineering role.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Translate complex technical concepts into business value for finance stakeholders.

• Depth in one or more areas, such as forecasting, LLM apps, or CPM modeling, with breadth across data, integrations, and platform operations.

title: Technical Program Manager, Science Strategy & Communications
locationText: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Accelerating scientific discovery is a core part of Anthropic's mission, and we believe the highest-leverage path to this is enabling researchers externally to use Claude effectively for their work. This involves communicating Claude’s rapidly improving scientific capabilities through outreach and editorial programs, as well as putting Claude in the hands of researchers through grants, ergonomic research tools, and access programs that help scientists do more with AI than was previously possible.

We’re hiring a Technical Program Manager to be the bridge between the researchers advancing Claude’s scientific capabilities and the outside scientific community. Embedded with the Discovery team, you’ll conceptualize and run the programs that get Claude into scientists’ hands and shape the Anthropic Science Blog, working with Communications, Editorial, Beneficial Deployments, and external partners such as universities, funders, and scientific societies.

This is a technical role, not a purely operational one. These programs already have strong operational and editorial owners. You bring research taste and a firsthand understanding of how academia works, so we’re looking for someone who has been a researcher themselves, ideally through a postdoc or beyond. You’ll have significant autonomy: once aligned with Discovery’s leads on strategy, you’ll drive decisions on what we fund, what we publish, and how we engage with academic communities

Key responsibilities

•
Act as the interface between research and the outside world. Stay close to the researchers working on Claude's scientific capabilities and translate rapid capability gain into use by external researchers.

•
Help set Anthropic’s external science strategy. Recommend which scientific areas and communities we focus on, and how our programs, collaborations, and communications fit together

•
Guide the scientific direction of the Anthropic Science Blog . Work with researchers and the Editorial team to identify and source stories internal and external stories worth telling, draft and edit posts, and keep a steady cadence of high-quality science writing.

•
Drive forward external science programs. Design, launch, and run grants and access programs such as AI for Science grants and Team plan offerings for research groups, as well as partnerships with scientific foundations and grantmaking organizations. Work with Beneficial Deployments on programs aimed at the highest-impact scientific areas.

•
Gather feedback from scientific communities. Identify usage patterns and gather feedback on how researchers use Claude and what capability gaps exist, and turn it into concrete recommendations for research and product teams.

Minimum qualifications

•
A PhD in a scientific or mathematical field, with a track record of original research

•
Demonstrated writing ability for both scientific domain and general-interest audiences, with enough understanding of how modern AI models are trained to write about them accurately.

•
Experience with the grants process, such as applying for and managing competitive funding, and ideally designing, reviewing, or administering funding programs

•
Deep engagement with frontier AI: you use these tools in your own work, understand where they're strong and where they fail, and take seriously the possibility that AI will transform every face of the scientific process within the next few years

•
Track record of driving multi-stakeholder projects to completion, and of coordinating people who are juggling other high-priority work. You’re resourceful, high-agency, and able to navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities.

description:
We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms.

We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one's overall well-being. 

We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare.

Rula is a remote-first company. We currently hire in most U.S. states, with the exception of Hawaii.

About the Role

We are seeking a Director of Finance Systems to own the technology behind Rula's accounting and financial reporting, and to help our Accounting team move toward a faster, more automated close. This is a chance to shape how a fast-growing mental health company runs its finances, with a scope that goes well beyond ERP administration and into AI, automation, and the controls that let us scale with confidence.

You will oversee our core finance systems, including NetSuite, Ramp, Zip, FloQast, and revenue reporting tools. You will be the project manager for new system launches and updates, and you will partner with Engineering to make sure Finance's needs are built in from the start.
